sections.Profile:
The Wagon Train pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1960, is an electro-mechanical, single-player game designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker. It features a Western theme inspired by the popular TV show Wagon Train , and its backglass artwork depicts actor Ward Bond, who starred in the series.
